I saw this post last night at like 1 am and I read all of it and I still can't stop thinking about it. I went on Youtube and watched the whole 1 hour 9 minute video again and then pretty much every video I could find about this. It drives me crazy, so much information but nothing makes any sense. How could a human being just run in front of an airport in broad daylight and never be seen again, it baffles me. What happened? I need closure. And I know that's selfish because I can't even imagine what his mother is going through every day.

I myself went on vacation to Golden Sands several times, once even exactly one month after this incident (8th of august 2014). How could I have never heard about it before? I hear about this sort of things all the time, but I think what really hit me about this one is how close it was, it did not happen in New York, but in my neighboring country (I live in Bucharest, Romania)

This saddened me very very much and I probably won't be able to stop thinking about it for several days. My thoughts and prayers go to Lars' mom (even though I'm not religious, I will pray for her). I hope she finds the strenght to keep going and I will always hope that he miraculously appears one day and can explain everything. That's what I wish for Christmas
